##### Abstract

We prove that, up to row and column permutations and complement operations, the only complement minimally non-totally unimodular matrices are the cycle matrices $C\_3$ and $C\_5$. This settles a conjecture of Chervet, Grappe, and Vallée. As a consequence, every simplicial cone generated by the rows of a totally equimodular matrix admits a regular unimodular Hilbert triangulation.
